name: Skillsync
long_description:
Skillsync is a local-first desktop app that frees your context from any single coding agent. Move a full session, including the conversation, reasoning, and tool history, between Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and any other agent with nothing lost. Keep your skills and memory in one searchable place, accessible from any agent via MCP. And when your team perfects a skill, it syncs to everyone automatically, so you stop digging through Slack threads and zip files to find the version that actually works.

The engine that translates sessions across agent formats, txcript, is open source and written in Rust. Say it once, and every agent and teammate has it.
one_liner: Move context across agents and teammates
